_README: Column removals that were DELIBERATE. `62`'s files_with_columns_lost_vs_backup compares a live table against its newest `.bak_*` and cannot tell an intentional removal from an accident, so without this file a deliberate removal keeps the gate red forever and the gate stops being read. A declaration is not a waiver: it must name the script that removed the column and why, and it only excuses THAT column on THAT file. Any other loss still fails.
